objective: Auditar en modo solo lectura la estructura real de dbo.Servidores_Conexiones sin SELECT *, sin UUID crudo, sin exponer secretos, sin tocar TABLAJERIA.sys.*, sin modificar datos.

queries.name: servidores_conexiones_exists
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Servidores_Conexiones'

queries.name: servidores_conexiones_columns_real
queries.sql: SELECT ORDINAL_POSITION, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, IS_NULLABLE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Servidores_Conexiones' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: servidores_conexiones_total_count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(1) AS total_rows FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones

queries.name: servidores_conexiones_log_exists
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Servidores_Conexiones_Log'

queries.name: servidores_conexiones_log_columns_real
queries.sql: SELECT ORDINAL_POSITION, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, IS_NULLABLE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Servidores_Conexiones_Log' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: servidores_related_tables
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Servidor%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Conexion%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Conex%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%API%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Sistema%' ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME
